December, 2019

Author: R.G. Avachat
Bench: R.G. Avachat
 4-ABA.1512-19.odt
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
 Anticipatory Bail Application No.1512 Of 2019
 Nagnath S/O. Haribhau Munde
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra
 ----
Mr.N.D.Kendre, Advocate for applicant
Mr.V.S.Badakh, App for respondent
 ----

Date : December 06, 2019

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Per Court :-
Heard. Perused the Fir.
2. Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 04.01.2020.
Learned APP waives notice for the respondent.

3. Till next date, in the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.162 of 2019 registered with Tadkalas Police Station, Tq.Purna, Dist. Parbhani, for the offences punishable under Sections 188,
328, 272, 273 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code and 2 4-ABA.1512-19 Sections 26(2)(IV),
27(3)(D), 27(3)(E), 30(2)(a) and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, the applicant be released on executing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand) with one surety in the like amount.

entities.text: Tadkalas Police Station, Tq.Purna, Dist. Parbhani
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant shall report to the concerned police station as and when required.
